#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Archive Claude Code transcripts as original JSONL and readable Markdown."""

# AI-assisted setup code. The hook idea was inspired by a CS 639 project's
# log_ai.py; this implementation was newly written for full-transcript
# archiving. See docs/ai-usage/README.md for provenance. Per-session folders
# named by start time were added with Claude Code (Opus 5.5) and checked by
# running the hook twice on a real transcript in a scratch project directory.

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def fenced(value: object) -> str:
    """Keep tool content literal even when it contains Markdown fences."""
    body = value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    fence = "`" * max(3, max((len(x) for x in re.findall(r"`+", body)), default=0) + 1)
    return f"{fence}\n{body}\n{fence}"


def render_block(block: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(block, str):
        return block
    if not isinstance(block, dict):
        return fenced(block)
    kind = block.get("type")
    if kind in {"thinking", "redacted_thinking"}:
        return ""
    if kind == "text":
        return block.get("text", "")
    if kind == "tool_use":
        return f"### Tool call: {block.get('name', 'unknown')}\n\n{fenced(block.get('input', {}))}"
    if kind == "tool_result":
        content = block.get("content", "")
        if isinstance(content, list):
            content = "\n\n".join(filter(None, (render_block(item) for item in content)))
        label = "Tool result (error)" if block.get("is_error") else "Tool result"
        return f"### {label}\n\n{fenced(content)}"
    # Preserve unfamiliar visible blocks and attachment references for review.
    return fenced(block)


def write_markdown(source: Path, destination: Path, session_id: str) -> int:
    """Render conversation and tool messages; retain the original JSONL separately."""
    parts = [
        "# Claude Code conversation transcript",
        f"Session: `{session_id}`",
        f"Original record: [{source.name}]({source.name})",
        "This readable view includes user/assistant messages and tool calls/results. "
        "Internal reasoning and session metadata are omitted; the original JSONL is retained.",
    ]
    messages = 0
    with source.open(encoding="utf-8") as transcript:
        for line in transcript:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            record = json.loads(line)
            if record.get("type") not in {"user", "assistant"}:
                continue
            message = record.get("message", {})
            content = message.get("content", "")
            blocks = content if isinstance(content, list) else [content]
            body = "\n\n".join(filter(None, (render_block(block) for block in blocks)))
            if not body:
                continue
            role = message.get("role", record["type"]).capitalize()
            timestamp = record.get("timestamp", "")
            messages += 1
            parts.extend([f"## {messages}. {role} — {timestamp}", body])
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        dir=destination.parent, prefix=".transcript-", mode="w", encoding="utf-8", delete=False
    ) as temp:
        temp_name = Path(temp.name)
        try:
            temp.write("\n\n".join(parts) + "\n")
            temp.flush()
            os.fsync(temp.fileno())
        except BaseException:
            temp_name.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise
    temp_name.replace(destination)
    return messages


def session_started_at(source: Path) -> datetime:
    """Earliest record timestamp; records are not always in time order."""
    earliest = None
    with source.open(encoding="utf-8") as transcript:
        for line in transcript:
            try:
                stamp = json.loads(line).get("timestamp")
                parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(stamp) if isinstance(stamp, str) else None
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if parsed and (earliest is None or parsed < earliest):
                earliest = parsed
    return earliest or datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def session_folder(root: Path, session_id: str, source: Path) -> Path:
    """One folder per session, e.g. 2026-10-11_2139_c6117488 (local start time).

    The hook runs after every response, so the name must not change within a
    session: it uses the session start, and an existing folder is reused.
    """
    short_id = session_id[:8]
    existing = sorted(p for p in root.glob(f"*_{short_id}") if p.is_dir())
    if existing:

"""Redaction rules for shared Claude Code transcripts (.claude/hooks/transcript_privacy.py).

Uses a made-up identity so the tests do not depend on this machine.
AI contribution: written with Claude Code (Opus 5.5).
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / ".claude" / "hooks"))

from transcript_privacy import Redactor  # noqa: E402

IDENTITY = {
    "home": ["/Users/alice.w"],
    "user": ["alice.w", "alice-w"],
    "host": ["alices-MacBook-Air.local", "alices-MacBook-Air"],
    "git-user": ["alice-99"],
    "git-email": ["[REDACTED:email]"],
}
PRIVATE_FILE = "# Plan\nDeadline: 2026-11-18 per advisor email\nSend CV and SOP draft to Dr. Quill\nList courses and semesters taken\n"


def redactor(**kwargs):
    return Redactor(IDENTITY, **kwargs)


def test_identity_values_are_replaced_with_markers():
    r = redactor()
    out = r.text("cd /Users/alice.w/proj && whoami -> alice.w on alices-MacBook-Air.local, -Users-alice-w-proj, author alice-99")
    assert out == ("cd ~/proj && whoami -> [REDACTED:user] on [REDACTED:host], "
                   "-Users-[REDACTED:user]-proj, author [REDACTED:git-user]")
    assert r.counts == {"home": 1, "user": 2, "host": 1, "git-user": 1}


def test_emails_are_redacted_except_allowlist():
    r = redactor()
    out = r.text("mail [REDACTED:email] or [REDACTED:email]; Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>")
    assert out == "mail [REDACTED:email] or [REDACTED:email]; Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>"
    assert r.counts["email"] == 2


def test_code_decorators_are_not_emails():
    assert redactor().text("x = 1\[REDACTED:email]\ndef spark(): ...") == "x = 1\[REDACTED:email]\ndef spark(): ..."


def test_regex_escaped_values_are_redacted():
    # e.g. a grep command that searches for the values themselves
    out = redactor().text(r"grep -E '[REDACTED:email]|/Users/alice\.w|alice\.w'")
    assert out == r"grep -E '[REDACTED:email]|~|[REDACTED:user]'"


def test_code_assignments_are_not_secrets():
    code = 'SECRET_TOKEN = re.compile(r"...")\nAPI_KEY = "abc123secret"'
    assert redactor().text(code) == 'SECRET_TOKEN = re.compile(r"...")\nAPI_KEY = "[REDACTED:secret]"'


def test_private_ips_and_secrets():
    r = redactor()
    out = r.text("using [REDACTED:ip] not 127.0.0.1; py4j==0.10.9.9; GROQ_API_KEY=[REDACTED:secret] "
                 "token [REDACTED:secret] Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED:secret]")
    assert "10.139" not in out and "127.0.0.1" in out and "0.10.9.9" in out
    assert "GROQ_API_KEY=[REDACTED:secret]" in out
    assert "ghp_" not in out and "Bearer [REDACTED:secret]" in out


def test_private_terms_are_case_insensitive():
    out = redactor(private_terms=["Quill"]).text("Per QUILL's screenshot and quill")
    assert out == "Per [REDACTED:private-term]'s screenshot and [REDACTED:private-term]"


def test_text_reproducing_a_private_file_is_replaced_whole():
    r = redactor(private_files={"docs/plan.md": PRIVATE_FILE})
    numbered = "\n".join(f"{i:>6}\t{line}" for i, line in enumerate(PRIVATE_FILE.splitlines(), 1))
    assert r.text(numbered) == "[REDACTED:private-file docs/plan.md]"
    # Mentioning the file or one line of it is fine.
    assert r.text("see docs/plan.md: Send CV and SOP draft to Dr. Quill") == "see docs/plan.md: Send CV and SOP draft to Dr. Quill"


def test_jsonl_records_stay_valid_and_reasoning_is_removed():
    raw = "\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in [
        {"type": "user", "cwd": "/Users/alice.w/proj", "message": {"content": "my email is [REDACTED:email]"}},
        {"type": "attachment", "schema": {"type": {"anyOf": ["string"]}}},  # non-string "type"
        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [
            {"type": "thinking", "thinking": "The user is probably in Madison", "signature": "abc123"},
            {"type": "text", "text": "Done."},
        ]}},
    ])

# Claude Code conversation records

The project hook in `.claude/settings.json` saves the complete Claude Code
JSONL transcript after each response and when a session ends, together with
a readable Markdown version. Each session gets its own folder named by its
local start time and the first 8 characters of the session id, so folders
sort chronologically:

```text
docs/ai-usage/
  2026-10-11_2139_c6117488/
    transcript.jsonl   # original record
    transcript.md      # messages and tool calls/results
```

The full session id is at the top of `transcript.md` and in every JSONL
record. The Markdown view omits internal reasoning and session metadata.
Later saves in the same session replace that folder's files. The hook does
not commit or push files.

Before committing a transcript, review it for credentials and private data.
Commit the reviewed transcript alongside the related code. If AI generates
code, add a nearby comment describing its contribution and how you verified
the result. The hook records only Claude Code conversations in this project.

This hook and its configuration were drafted with Codex assistance during
project setup.

The first analysis framework (`src/etf_risk/` ingest, validate, model and
spark_pipeline modules, plus `tests/`) was drafted with Claude Code (Opus 5.5)
on 2026-10-11. Each file's docstring states the AI contribution and how it
was verified; the model-breach branch in `model.simulate_path` was written
by the project author.

The transcript hook was inspired by the log_ai.py script in a CS639 project.
